_comment: The only two ways to reach the demos, and the only place either is written. build.py reads this file; no page, partial or script contains a phone number or a wa.me link. whatsappBot.url is the link the site has always used, pre-filled text included. ivrLine is voice only: never offer WhatsApp or SMS on it. Its tip and indiaTip are the two tooltips of the split phone pill (footer, Work page, Missed Lead Responder case study).

ivrLine.label: Hear the phone demo (US number)
ivrLine.tip: Call to try our IVR and missed-call responder.
ivrLine.indiaTip: Calling from India needs international calling enabled on your SIM.
ivrLine.note: Calling from India needs international calling. Prefer not to?
